claims.text: Defense Intelligence Reference Document titled "Advanced Nuclear Propulsion for Manned Deep Space Missions", series "Acquisition Threat Support", published 2010-03-11 with an Intelligence Cut-Off Date (ICOD) of 2009-12-01, DIA document number DIA-08-1003-007. Released by DIA under FOIA and posted in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.

Inside cover reads: "This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted b(3) 10 USC 424] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program" and directs questions to the "AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100".

Author name is withheld in the DIA-released copy under FOIA exemption (b)(6); the "Prepared by:" line is withheld under (b)(3) 10 USC 424. The released cover therefore does not attribute the DIRD to a named author.
Released PDF is 37 pages, marked UNCLASSIFIED//FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY (FOUO caveat partially illegible in the scan).

Authored by Dr F. Winterberg of the University of Nevada-Reno, per the DIA list of 38 AAWSAP products transmitted to the Senate Armed Services Committee on 9 January 2018 (item 2). The released PDF redacts the author name under FOIA exemption (b)(6).

Cover page reads: "11 March 2010 / ICOD: 1 December 2009 / DIA-08-1003-007", series "Acquisition Threat Support". The OCR renders the date field as "reDO" and the number as "DIA-OS-1003-007"; these are scan artefacts for ICOD and DIA-08-.

Inside cover states the product is "one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program" and directs questions to the AAWSA Program Manager, DIA, Bldg 6000, Washington DC 20340-5100.

connections.note: The released document names the programme itself.
